examples.arabic: بالتالي، قرروا يتواصلوا مع زملائهم الطلاب لترتيب أول اجتماع لهم الأسبوع القادم.
examples.english: Therefore, they decided to contact their fellow students to arrange their first meeting next week.
examples.transliteration: Bil-tali, qarraroo yitwasaloo ma' zumalai'ihim el-ṭullab li-tartib awwal ijtima' lahom el-usbū' el-qadem.
examples.storyTitle: Echoes of News at the University

examples.arabic: بعد ما خلصت اكلت اول لقمة وكانت لذيذة كتير
examples.english: After I finished, I ate the first bite and it was very delicious.
examples.transliteration: Ba'ed ma khallaṣet akalt awwal loqme w-kanat ladheedha kteer.

examples.arabic: بس اول شي لازم نشتري اغراض من السوق
examples.english: But first, we need to buy things from the market.
examples.transliteration: Bas awwal shi lazim neshtari aghrad men es-souq.

examples.arabic: اليوم كان اول يوم شغل بعد العطلة والكل كان كسلان
examples.english: Today was the first day of work after the holiday and everyone was lazy
examples.transliteration: El youm kan awwal youm shoghl ba'd el otleh wal kull kan kaslan

examples.arabic: قبل نهاية الشوط الأول هاد اللاعب أخذ الكرة وسجل ثلاث نقاط حلوة
examples.english: Before the end of the first half, this player took the ball and scored three nice points
examples.transliteration: qabl nihāyet ish-shōṭ il-ʾawwal hād il-lāʿeb ʾakhað il-kura w-sajjal talāt niqāṭ ḥilwe

examples.arabic: بالأول قطعت البصل وبعدين قليت الدجاج وسمعت صوت الطقطقة
examples.english: First I chopped the onions, then I fried the chicken and heard the sizzling sound.
examples.transliteration: Bel-awwal qaṭṭa't el-baṣal w ba'dein qaleit ed-djaj w same't ṣawt eṭ-ṭaqṭaqa.
